## Alignment Gate
Goal and actor: Codex produces a standalone offline bookmark-manager implementation plan.
Deliverable and inputs: one Markdown plan returned in the response only.
In scope: Node.js TypeScript, local JSON, add, list, remove, generated IDs, required URLs, optional title and tags.
Explicit exclusions: no implementation, cloud sync, graphical interfaces, external services, or file changes.
Constraints: Target Tool Codex; Prompt Budget 900 English words maximum.
Acceptance Criteria and verification evidence: add creates an ID; list shows it; remove <id> removes it; later list does not show it; JSON reflects mutations; tests cover URL validation and malformed JSON.
Failure conditions and edge cases: invalid URL, missing ID, and malformed JSON fail clearly.
Remaining assumptions: none.
Reply approve to authorize generation of the three delivery artifacts.

### English Final Prompt
```text
You are Codex. Return one standalone Markdown implementation plan only; do not implement or edit files. Use Node.js with TypeScript and local JSON. Define add, list, remove, generated IDs, required URL, optional title and tags. Exclude cloud sync, graphical interfaces, and external services. Specify this verification: add creates an ID, list shows it, remove <id> removes it, later list does not show it, and JSON reflects mutations. Specify automated tests for URL validation and malformed JSON. Invalid URLs, missing IDs, and malformed JSON must fail clearly.
```
### Review Translation
```text
당신은 Codex입니다. 파일을 구현하거나 수정하지 말고 독립적인 Markdown 계획 하나만 반환하세요. Node.js TypeScript와 로컬 JSON을 사용하고 add, list, remove, 생성 ID, 필수 URL, 선택 제목과 태그를 정의하세요. 클라우드 동기화, GUI, 외부 서비스는 제외하세요. add가 ID를 만들고 list가 보이며 remove <id> 뒤 list에 없고 JSON 변경을 반영하는 검증과 URL 검증 및 손상 JSON 자동화 테스트를 명시하세요. 잘못된 URL, 없는 ID, 손상 JSON은 명확히 실패해야 합니다.
```
### Run Instructions
Start a **Fresh Run** in **Codex** and paste **only the English Final Prompt**. Prompt Budget: 900 English words maximum. Quality Gate: **Passed**. Success check mapped to the approved criterion: run add, list, remove <id>, then list; verify the ID disappears and local JSON reflects both mutations. Review Translation is review-only.
